(Capacity: 15,400) |champion = |tourney =[[2016 NCAA Tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2015–16 Big Ten men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Iowa]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by sixth–year head coach [[Fran McCaffery]] and played their home games at [[Carver–Hawkeye Arena]]. They finished season 22–11, 12–6 record in Big Ten play to finish in a four-way tie for third place. In the [[2016 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they were upset by [[2015–16 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] in the second round. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]] in the first round before losing to eventual National Champion [[2015–16 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2014–15 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Hawkeyes]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] with a 22–12 record, 12–6 in [[2014–15 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|conference play]] finishing in third place. They lost to [[2014–15 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round of the [[2014–15 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten tournament]] and received an at-large bid in the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2014–15 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]] in the First Round and lost to [[2014–15 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the Third Round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
